governance_note: Review shape, symmetry, sparsity, rank, scaling, definiteness, conditioning, and data source before factorization.
Match LU, QR, Cholesky, eigen, Schur, SVD, sparse, or low-rank workflow to task and matrix structure.
Document row and column permutations used for stability, sparsity preservation, or fill-in reduction.
State tolerance used for rank estimates, pseudoinverses, and low-rank approximation.
Report factorization reconstruction error, approximation error, and solve residuals where relevant.
Report condition estimates or singular spectra for sensitive computations.
Interpret factors, modes, and components through domain review rather than treating them as automatic causes.
Communicate factorization limits, approximation loss, diagnostics, and assumption boundaries.
